title: Copilot Studio: PPAC Reporting API for Copilot Credit usage data
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, preview reporting operation and documented limitations are supported. The monthly-limit path stops on the correct page but should include the remaining steps to configure the limit and stop usage.

claims.claim: The roadmap product is Microsoft Copilot Studio.
claims.quote: "products": ["Microsoft Copilot Studio"]

claims.claim: Microsoft plans access to Copilot Studio Copilot Credit usage through the Power Platform API.
claims.quote: Power Platform reporting API for Copilot credits provides customers with access to Copilot Credit usage from Copilot Studio through the Power Platform API

claims.claim: The planned API extends existing Power Platform admin center reports.
claims.quote: extending the existing reports available in the Power Platform Admin Center.

claims.claim: Learn documents programmatic Copilot Credit usage reporting in public preview with an end-to-end tutorial.
claims.quote: The usage reports API is in public preview.

claims.claim: The documented reporting workflow starts by submitting an asynchronous generation request.
claims.quote: Starts generating a Copilot Studio licensing report for your tenant over the requested date range. Generation runs asynchronously; poll the URL in the Location header for status.

claims.claim: The documented reporting workflow polls for completion before downloading the file.
claims.quote: Poll the operation until its status is Succeeded or Failed. Follow the polling interval specified by Retry-After.

claims.claim: The generated report download is gzip-compressed.
claims.quote: Report retrieval requires delegated administrator authentication and follows an asynchronous workflow: submit a request, poll for completion, and download the gzip-compressed file.

claims.where: What's changing; controls[0].note; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft does not explicitly identify the documented preview operation as the roadmap's named PPAC Reporting API.
claims.quote: Searched: "PPAC Reporting API" Copilot licensing default roles enable; "copilotstudio/licensing/reports" "license". Opened the capacity page, reporting tutorial and Generate Licensing Report reference; none explicitly equates the names.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters
claims.claim: The arrival default of the roadmap's API is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: "PPAC Reporting API" Copilot licensing default roles enable; "Copilot" "usage reports API" "default" "permissions". Read roadmap, capacity page, tutorial and operation reference; none states the roadmap feature's arrival default.

claims.claim: Power Platform admin center > Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Summary > Download report reaches consumption report downloads.
claims.quote: On the navigation pane, select Licensing. In the Licensing pane, under Products, select Copilot Studio. Select the Summary tab. Select Download report.

claims.claim: POST https://api.powerplatform.com/copilotstudio/licensing/reports/{ReportName}?api-version=2024-10-01 generates a tenant licensing report.
claims.quote: POST https://api.powerplatform.com/copilotstudio/licensing/reports/{ReportName}?api-version=2024-10-01

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The documented preview report operation requires a Global, Dynamics 365 or Power Platform administrator.
claims.quote: Requires the Global, Dynamics 365, or Power Platform administrator role.

claims.claim: The report request body uses startDate and endDate for the report date range.
claims.quote: endDate: The inclusive UTC end date of the report range. Must be on or after the start date. startDate: The inclusive UTC start date of the report range.

claims.claim: The report request body supports the granularity property.
claims.quote: granularity: The granularity of a licensing report. Daily returns one row per day in the date range, and Summary returns a single summarized row for the whole range.

claims.where: Why it matters; controls[0].governs; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Administrators can manually download existing consumption reports organised by environment, agent or user.
claims.quote: From the Summary tab, you can download reports that organize consumption by environment, agent, or user.

claims.claim: The tutorial says API report data can be combined with other data sources.
claims.quote: Use this data to automate decisions, combine it with other data sources, or maintain a long-term history beyond the 30-day reporting window.

claims.claim: The tutorial describes retaining report data as long-term history beyond its 30-day reporting window.
claims.quote: Use this data to automate decisions, combine it with other data sources, or maintain a long-term history beyond the 30-day reporting window.

claims.claim: The existing user report can show unauthenticated sessions under user ID 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 without a user name.
claims.quote: In the user report, usage from sessions where the user didn't sign in, for example on an agent that doesn't require authentication, can appear under the user ID 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 with no user name.

claims.claim: The documented usage reports API supports delegated user authentication only.
claims.quote: The usage reports API supports delegated (user) authentication only

claims.claim: Application-only service principal tokens are not supported by the documented usage reports API.
claims.quote: application-only (service principal) tokens aren't supported.

claims.claim: A scheduled script using the documented preview operation must use delegated administrator authentication.
claims.quote: Report retrieval requires delegated administrator authentication

claims.claim: Roles and prerequisites specifically attributed to the roadmap's named API are not separately published.
claims.quote: Searched: "PPAC Reporting API" Copilot licensing default roles enable; Copilot Studio licensing reports API pricing license charge permissions enable disable. Read roadmap, tutorial and Generate Licensing Report; published roles describe the preview operation.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: The authorisation design for the roadmap's named API is not separately documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "PPAC Reporting API" Copilot licensing default roles enable; "Copilot" "usage reports API" "default" "permissions". Read roadmap, reporting tutorial and operation reference; only the documented preview's authentication is stated.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance
claims.claim: No API for setting a Copilot Studio agent's monthly credit limit is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio monthly limit API PowerShell pac admin; site:learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/power-platform agent monthly limit; Copilot limit Set-AdminPowerApp. Read capacity and harness cost pages and pac copilot-studio command-list excerpt; no limit-setting call found.

claims.claim: Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Summary > Manage Agents reaches the page for monthly credit limits and hard stops.
claims.quote: On the Summary tab, select Manage Agents. The Agents page appears where you can: ... You can set a monthly limit for any agent directly from this page.
claims.fix: Extend controls[1].ui.path and the matching table path to 'Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Summary > Manage Agents > agent > Set limit > Stop usage'. Add https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/manage-usage-microsoft-copilot-harness to sources; its 'Set a monthly limit for an agent' section gives these remaining steps and states that capacity and consumption controls apply across Copilot Studio.

claims.where: controls[1].governs; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance controls
claims.claim: Administrators can set monthly consumption limits for individual Copilot Studio agents as an existing cost control.
claims.quote: Admins can set monthly consumption limits for each Copilot Studio agent, regardless of whether the environment uses prepaid capacity or pay-as-you-go billing.

claims.claim: An agent monthly limit has a configurable hard stop that turns the agent off at the limit.
claims.quote: After you set limits, you can configure two key guardrails: ... Hard stop: The agent is automatically turned off once it hits the defined limit.

claims.claim: Limits are not applied instantly and an agent can continue responding for some time after reaching its limit.
claims.quote: Limits aren't applied instantly. An agent can continue to respond for some time after it reaches its limit, so set limits and notification thresholds with some margin.

claims.claim: An agent's monthly limit does not stop the agent flows it calls.
claims.quote: An agent's monthly limit doesn't stop the agent flows that the agent calls. Agent flows are billed and checked for capacity separately

claims.claim: The tutorial and capacity documentation mark programmatic usage reporting as preview and subject to change.
claims.quote:
Programmatic access to usage reports (preview)

[This article is prerelease documentation and is subject to change.]

claims.claim: The tutorial says report submissions can return 429 Too Many Requests under service protection.
claims.quote: Report submissions can return 429 Too Many Requests when service protection is enforced. A rejected submission doesn't start a report.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Entitlement specifically for calling the roadmap's reporting API is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio licensing reports API pricing license charge permissions enable disable; "copilotstudio/licensing/reports" "license". Read tutorial prerequisites, Generate Licensing Report, requirements-licensing and billing-licensing; no API-specific entitlement stated.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Assign licenses and manage access to Copilot Studio lists a Copilot Studio User License per user creating and managing standard-harness agents.
claims.quote: A license for each user, also known as a per user license (or Copilot Studio User License as referred to on the Microsoft 365 admin center). Assign this license to individual users who need access to create and manage agents.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The same licensing page lists an organisational tenant licence for creating and managing agents.
claims.quote: A license for your organization, also known as a tenant license (or Copilot Studio as referred to on the Microsoft 365 admin center).

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The licensing overview also lists Copilot Studio authors access as a product-access route.
claims.quote: To use Copilot Studio, you need one of the following configurations: ... Copilot Studio authors role in Power Platform admin center.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The licensing overview lists a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence as a product-access route.
claims.quote: To use Copilot Studio, you need one of the following configurations: ... Microsoft 365 Copilot license

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The licensing overview lists a Copilot Studio trial licence as a product-access route.
claims.quote: To use Copilot Studio, you need one of the following configurations: ... Copilot Studio trial license.

claims.claim: Neither of the two cited product licensing pages mentions reporting APIs.
claims.quote: Searched: "copilotstudio/licensing/reports" "license"; Copilot Studio licensing reports API pricing license charge permissions enable disable. Read requirements-licensing and billing-licensing in full; neither mentions reporting APIs.

claims.claim: A charge or rate specifically for calling the reporting API is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio licensing reports API pricing license charge permissions enable disable; "copilotstudio/licensing/reports" "license". Read tutorial, report operation reference, capacity and both licensing pages; none states an API-call price.

claims.claim: The admin centre reports agent consumption in Copilot Credits.
claims.quote: Copilot Credits measure agent usage.

claims.claim: An agent interaction can consume several credits because its features have their own rates.
claims.quote: One interaction with an agent can consume several credits because each feature the agent uses in that interaction has its own rate.

claims.claim: The tutorial's Copilot Studio workflow client requires sufficient Copilot Credits to run the workflow.
claims.quote: Access to Copilot Studio with permission to create workflows, a Power Platform for Admins V2 connection with an OAuth Connection authentication type, and sufficient Copilot Credits to run the workflow.

claims.claim: The tutorial's Power Automate client requires a licence that includes standard connectors.
claims.quote: A Power Automate license that includes standard connectors, and permission to create a Power Platform for Admins V2 connection with an OAuth Connection authentication type.

claims.claim: Sovereign clouds are not currently supported by the documented preview usage reports API.
claims.quote: The usage reports API is in public preview. Sovereign clouds aren't currently supported.

claims.claim: The admin centre's user report documents user-level consumption for standard-harness agents.
claims.quote: The reports show consumption by environment and agent. For agents powered by the standard harness, the user report also shows consumption by user.

claims.claim: A switch to enable or disable the roadmap's named API, or a feature-specific caller restriction, is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "PPAC Reporting API" Copilot licensing default roles enable; Copilot Studio licensing reports API pricing license charge permissions enable disable. Read capacity page, tutorial and report reference; they document preview caller roles but no separate roadmap-API switch.
